query: Death Valley Furnace Creek DEVC1 station highest daily maximum temperature recorded so far July 2026, actual observations July 7-13 2026
answer:
I've completed the research on the Death Valley / Furnace Creek (DEVC1) station temperatures for July 2026.

## Summary

**Station:** DEVC1 = "Visitors Center at Furnace Creek Death Valley" — the official NWS/NPS climate station.

**July 7–13, 2026 actual observations (daily maximums):**
| Date | High |
|------|------|
| Jul 7 | 117°F |
| Jul 8 | 117°F |
| Jul 9 | 119°F |
| Jul 10 | 119°F |
| Jul 11 | 119°F |
| Jul 12 | 113°F |
| Jul 13 | 109°F |

**Highest in the July 7–13 window: 119°F** (reached on July 9, 10, and 11).

**Highest daily maximum so far in all of July 2026 (through July 16): 121°F on July 15** — this exceeds the July 7–13 peak. So the answer depends on scope: **119°F** if strictly July 7–13, or **121°F (July 15)** if the full month-to-date.

**Key caveats:**
- July 2026 has run near the long-term average — well below July 2024's extreme (121.9°F monthly average high) and far below all-time records (130°F in 2021, 134°F in 1913).
- Data comes from ExtremeWeatherWatch's NOAA-sourced daily record for the Furnace Creek station (I could not directly scrape the weather.gov DEVC1 timeseries or timeanddate, which returned 403).
- **Important:** AccuWeather's "Death Valley" ZIP 92384 is a *different* San Bernardino County location, not Furnace Creek/DEVC1, and shows different (lower) values — it should not be used for this station.
